reviews_verbatim.author: Marianne Parker
reviews_verbatim.text: Travis showed up within hours of first phone call. He got right to work and finished the job promptly without incident.

reviews_verbatim.author: Diana Chagnon
reviews_verbatim.text: Another year another great job! Travis is super nice and accommodating. You cannot go wrong hiring him.

reviews_verbatim.author: Camilo Cartaya
reviews_verbatim.text: Honestly, I haven't been able to enjoy it myself just yet, but my wife says it looks fantastic.

brand_vibe: Logo seen in the business's own marketing graphics: navy blue plate, orange circle, bright blue cartoon shark/dolphin mascot holding a pressure washer wand, white wordmark 'FLORIDA WASH SOLUTIONS'. Site palette derived from these: deep ocean blue (#1f5f86), bright sky/cerulean blue (#3fa0cf), pale sky soft tone (#dbeef6/#e4eef4), on a clean light base, evoking clean water and a bright Florida sky.
build_variant: Variante adaptada (FORGE-BRIEF 0.b / PIPELINE Fase 3 punto 5): no fixed address (home-service, no-office business) -> omitted map, used a real job photo instead; no published prices -> service cards carry 'Free quote' + call CTA instead of a dollar amount; no booking platform -> all CTAs go to tel:+12395711546; reviews -> 3 real verbatim Google quotes kept in their original English, untranslated.
